provenance.scope: A1(1급) vocabulary reinforcement — 65 headwords (29 verbs, 26 adjectives, 10 nouns) from the NIKL KIIQ 2017 grade-1 gap list (not yet live, not in the Batch 26, 27 or 28 drafts). Batch 29 = all remaining grade-1 verbs + adjectives + nouns; the remaining adverbs (19), pronouns (13), dependent nouns (13) and determiners (11) are deferred to Batch 30. No under-12 A1 pack had a matching candidate (a1_colors needs color adjectives -- none remain grade-1; a1_partner_meet_names_1 needs an honorific kinship-address term -- none remain), so all 65 words went into 6 new packs (5 full 12-word packs + 1 unavoidable 5-word pack, since 65 does not divide evenly by 12). Original clean-room authoring (KO/DE/EN), seeded only by NIKL 2017 kiiq grade-1 headword selection (KOGL Type-1). Follows the persona (character_profiles.json recurringCharacters) and liveliness rules set for Batch 26-28.

provenance.predicateSlotWaiverNote: Verb/adjective rows whose cloze answer spans a wide-open predicate slot (invitation '우리 같이 ＿＿＿?', bare imperative '가방을 ＿＿＿.', minimal-response '정말 ＿＿＿.'/'제 생각도 ＿＿＿.'/'오늘 날씨가 ＿＿＿?' etc., where several real verbs/adjectives of the same shape would also complete the sentence validly) use the Batch 25-28 predicate-slot waiver technique (distractor_rules.py: bare dictionary-form verbs/adjectives, or for 잘하다/못하다's '잘 ＿' slot, a bare dictionary-form verb with '잘' prefixed) instead of same-ending conjugated nouns/verbs -- tagged per-row as waiver='predicate_slot' in the generator data and listed in the review packet.
provenance.malDecisionNote: 말다 (NIKL grade-1 verb) is almost exclusively used in modern Korean as the bound auxiliary of '-지 말다' (prohibitive) or '-고 말다' (completive) -- both supra-1급 grammar not in this batch's permitted ending list (-아/어요, -았/었어요, -(으)세요, -(으)ㄹ까요?, -고 싶어요, -지 않아요, -지 못해요, -(으)ㄹ 수 있어요), and '-지 말다' specifically was already rejected as 2급 in Batch 28's R8 review (늦다 rewrite). Rather than drop the headword, this batch uses 말다's other, non-auxiliary dictionary sense ('to roll/wrap', e.g. 김밥을 말다) with a plain -아/어요 sentence. Flagged 판정 필요 in the review packet.

predicateSlotWaiverRows.vocab_a1_0719: 놀다 -- '크리스티안 씨, 우리 같이 ＿＿＿?' is an open invitation slot (갈까요/볼까요/먹을까요... all valid); waiver = bare dictionary-form verbs (자다/입다/읽다).
predicateSlotWaiverRows.vocab_a1_0721: 들다(들어요, held-object sense) -- '가방을 ＿＿＿.' is an open imperative slot (파세요/사세요/보세요 all valid); waiver = bare dictionary-form verbs (자다/입다/읽다).
predicateSlotWaiverRows.vocab_a1_0735: 잘하다 -- '민호 씨는 요리를 ＿＿＿.' fused-하다 slot is open for many activities; waiver = '잘 ' + bare dictionary-form verb (잘 읽다/잘 입다/잘 타다), not a conjugated noun.
predicateSlotWaiverRows.vocab_a1_0737: 지내다 -- '요즘 ' + bare predicate '＿＿＿?' (minimal-response shape); waiver = bare dictionary-form verbs (읽다/입다/타다).
predicateSlotWaiverRows.vocab_a1_0740: 못하다 -- '크리스티안 씨는 한국어를 잘 ＿＿＿.' same '잘 + verb' open slot as 잘하다; waiver = '잘 ' + bare dictionary-form verb.
predicateSlotWaiverRows.vocab_a1_0745: 고맙다 -- '정말 ＿＿＿.' minimal-response shape; waiver = bare dictionary-form adjectives is not applicable (고맙다 IS an adjective already used bare) -- distractors are same-ending adjectives (작아요/많아요/비싸요) chosen because none naturally complete '정말 ＿' as a plausible reply either; tagged waiver out of caution, not because a same-form pool was unavailable.
